name: Brigade Kanakapura Road
tagline: Expansive 3 and 4 bed homes on Kanakapura Road
overview: An upcoming Brigade Group development on Kanakapura Road, one of South Bengaluru's most liveable residential corridors — known for greener surroundings, improving infrastructure and a calmer environment compared to denser parts of the city. The project is planned around expansive, low-density 3 and 4 bed homes designed for long-term liveability across life stages.
highlights: Low-density living with expansive 3 and 4 bed homes
Kanakapura Road corridor — greener surroundings, improving infrastructure
Direct Namma Metro Green Line connectivity to Majestic, Yeshwanthpur and central Bengaluru
NICE Road access to Electronic City, Mysore Road and Bannerghatta Road
Close to Art of Living International Center and Pyramid Valley wellness destinations
Easy access to JP Nagar & Jayanagar's social infrastructure and retail
By Brigade Group — nearly four decades of development experience, 100+ million sq.ft delivered

locationInfo.summary: Located on Kanakapura Road in South Bengaluru, with direct Namma Metro Green Line access, NICE Road connectivity, and proximity to JP Nagar, Jayanagar and the Electronic City IT corridor.
